name: Hacker News (Algolia API)
voice: firsthand for engineers; secondhand about non-tech users
target: optional topic prefixed to each phrase, e.g. a product or tool name

name: Reddit (OAuth API)
target: subreddit, e.g. r/<subreddit>. Credentials: a "script" app at reddit.com/prefs/apps; the public JSON returns 403

name: Reddit archive (PullPush)
target: subreddit, e.g. r/<subreddit>. The archive is patchy and can return nothing for a subreddit

name: Product Hunt comments (GraphQL API)
target: post slug, e.g. <product-slug>. Token: a developer token at producthunt.com/v2/oauth/applications

name: Trustpilot reviews
target: company domain, e.g. example.com. Bot protection often returns 403; then save reviews in 01-collect/manual/trustpilot/

name: G2 reviews (manual export)
target: product name; save reviews as .md files in 01-collect/manual/g2/ (the site blocks scripted access)

name: Discord community (manual export)
target: server/channel; save messages as .md files in 01-collect/manual/discord/

name: Skool community (manual export)
target: community; save posts as .md files in 01-collect/manual/skool/

name: X recent search (API, or manual export)
target: optional query prefix, e.g. a product or tool name. Without a token, save posts in 01-collect/manual/x/. API search covers only the last 7 days

name: Web search fallback (agent-driven)
target: the agent saves verbatim items as .md files in 01-collect/manual/websearch/. Low reach
